cards.meaning: resignation — the act of voluntarily giving up or leaving a position or office
cards.example: Nanawagan si Duterte na mag-desisyon na si Marcos hinggil sa kanyang pagbibitiw, ngunit tuluyang binalewala ito ng Malacañang.
cards.exampleMeaning: Duterte called on Marcos to decide on his resignation, but Malacañang flatly dismissed it.
cards.note: Formal/legal term for voluntary resignation from office — distinct from 'pagpapatalsik' (ouster/removal), which implies force. Standard word in political news for a call to step down.
cards.tiesTo: VP Sara Duterte's public call for Marcos to resign

cards.meaning: baseless — without foundation or legal/factual grounds
cards.example: Sinabi ng Malacañang na walang-batayan ang panawagan ni Duterte, dahil wala itong legal na saligan.
cards.exampleMeaning: Malacañang said Duterte's call was baseless, since it had no legal grounding.
cards.note: Root is 'batayan' (basis/foundation) — the standard phrase for dismissing an accusation or demand as unfounded in political rebuttals, distinct from 'walang-kwenta' (worthless), which is dismissive rather than evidentiary.
cards.tiesTo: Malacañang's rejection of Duterte's resignation call

cards.meaning: by contrast; in comparison — formal connective for setting two facts or figures side by side
cards.example: 中国工业生产同比增长5.2%,相比之下,零售销售只增长了0.4%。
cards.examplePinyin: Zhōngguó gōngyè shēngchǎn tóngbǐ zēngzhǎng bǎi fēn zhī wǔ diǎn èr, xiāngbǐ zhī xià, língshòu xiāoshòu zhǐ zēngzhǎng le bǎi fēn zhī líng diǎn sì.
cards.exampleMeaning: China's industrial production rose 5.2% year-on-year; by contrast, retail sales grew only 0.4%.
cards.note: 书面语/formal register, common in economic reporting to juxtapose two data points. Contrast with the more casual, general-purpose '但是' — '相比之下' specifically frames a side-by-side comparison of figures or results.
cards.tiesTo: China's August activity data — industrial output vs. retail sales divergence

cards.meaning: to drive along; to pull (an economic indicator) — formal collocation, pairs with growth/consumption/domestic demand/the economy
cards.example: 如果内需持续疲软,出口和工业生产恐怕难以单独拉动经济增长。
cards.examplePinyin: Rúguǒ nèixū chíxù píruǎn, chūkǒu hé gōngyè shēngchǎn kǒngpà nányǐ dāndú lādòng jīngjì zēngzhǎng.
cards.exampleMeaning: If domestic demand keeps stalling, exports and industrial output alone will struggle to drive economic growth.
cards.note: Formal economic-register verb for one factor pulling an aggregate figure up — the standard term in GDP-component analysis (投资拉动, 消费拉动, 出口拉动). Near-synonym '推动' (tuīdòng, 'to push forward/promote') is more general-purpose.
cards.tiesTo: China's August activity data — industrial output vs. retail sales divergence
